subject: AP onboarding: Starlight Systems PO requirements and identity proofing
messages:
From: Emma Lowe <emma.lowe@starlightsys.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Team <ap@starlightsys.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor setup - what Starlight needs from Redwood

Hi Mina and Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo — team loved the latency figures. Procurement asked me to pull together the specific items they need to create Redwood as a vendor in Starlight's AP system so we can route POs and pay on standard terms. Can you confirm the checklist below and tell me who on your side will be the primary contact for onboarding?

Starlight required items (we need one of the following for each):
- Legal entity name and EIN/SIRET
- Remit bank details (ACH/IBAN) or payment instructions (we can mask account numbers in the portal)
- Invoice remittance email and preferred invoice format (PDF/UBL/CSV)
- PO matching fields: PO number, line-level quantity, contract ref
- Tax/VAT certificate or US W-9
- AP contact and ticketing email for exceptions
- SFTP/HTTPS endpoint for automated invoice ingest (optional but preferred)

Also: do you support self-bill / credit-note flow if we need to net against prepayments?

Appreciate a quick reply — procurement wants to start the vendor record creation this week.

Cheers,
Emma
Emma Lowe
Head of Procurement
Starlight Systems
emma.lowe@starlightsys.com

---
Attachments: none
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lowe <emma.lowe@starlightsys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor setup - what Starlight needs from Redwood

Hi Emma — thanks for the list. We're happy to move quickly. Answers inline and followed by next steps.

- Legal entity & tax ID: Redwood Inference, Inc. / EIN: 54-1234567. We can provide a signed W-9 for US tax purposes.
- Remit bank details: we prefer ACH. We'll send a banking instruction PDF (bank account number masked in portal exports).
- Invoice remittance: remit@redwood.ai. We can deliver PDF invoices and also a nightly CSV for automated ingest.
- PO matching: standard PO number + line-level SKU mapping. We can include contract_ref in invoice metadata.
- Tax/VAT: W-9 for US entity. If you need VAT docs for EU legal entities (we have a EU billing entity), we can provide that too — who will be the tax reviewer?
- AP contact: remit@redwood.ai and billing_ops@redwood.ai (for exception tickets)
- SFTP/HTTPS: we can expose an SFTP endpoint, or provide push to your API. Karthik can share technical spec.
- Self-bill: we prefer Redwood to issue invoices; self-bill requests require a signed agreement. Open to a limited pilot if needed.

Next steps proposed:
1) Karthik to share SFTP/CSV schema and expected fields.
2) I will send a scanned W-9 and bank remit stub.
3) Emma, if Starlight can create a draft vendor record, send the vendor id back so we can verify.

Thanks — I'll loop Marissa to sync on any PO-term exceptions (early pay, retainers, etc.).

Best,
Mina Haddad
Finance Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

---
Attachments: none
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lowe <emma.lowe@starlightsys.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor setup - what Starlight needs from Redwood

Emma / Mina — here is the digest of the invoice ingest spec we support:

- Preferred automated flow: nightly CSV push (UTF-8) or SFTP pickup. CSV columns we populate: invoice_id, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), remit_email, po_number, line_item_sku, qty, unit_price, tax_amount, total_amount, contract_ref
- Alternate: UBL 2.1 XML with PO-linked references
- Payment remittance metadata: bank_name, routing_number (masked in portal export), payment_method (ACH/SEPA/Wire), currency
- Error handling: our ingest will return a 2xx when accepted, or a 4xx with field-level error codes; we can provide a daily reconciliation report to your AP.

I'll attach the sample CSV mapping and a short SFTP onboarding checklist (filename: AP_SFTP_Ingest_Spec.csv). If Starlight prefers DocuSign for bank attestation, we can sign.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
